entries.intent: Package the Observe->Improve loop as a standalone scored diagnostic instead of a bespoke consulting engagement
entries.evidence: 3 independent LinkedIn commenters asked for a self-check version of the loop, not a custom engagement
entries.reasoning: A repeatable scored diagnostic is far cheaper to deliver than 1:1 consulting and doubles as a lead magnet into paid consulting
entries.outcome: Approved: build a 12-question lifecycle diagnostic template
entries.lesson_learned: Signal from 3+ people asking the same question is strong enough to prototype before a fourth request arrives
